Name: Anatomy Mannequins
Author: idermailer
Description:
[b][color=#ff0000][size=5]!!! If you don't clear all the mannequins before removing this mod,  you will not be able to load your save !!![/size][/color][/b]
You will need to re-download and install the mod again and then remove all mannequins from this mod, or edit your save file directly.


[b][size=4]What does this mod do?[/size][/b]
Add mannequins with exposed internal organs and half-body muscles. These mannequins can be traded in the casino, and are sometimes dropped by ghosts. Or maybe someone picks them up and sells them...?

[b][size=4]Options for those who lack courage[/size][/b]
You can disable curses or set ghost sprites invisible.

[size=4][b]Suggestions for those who like unpleasant things[/b][/size]
I've also prepared more unpleasant ghost sprites.
